executionOrder.title: Require the immutable dispatch guide
executionOrder.action: Use the server-issued guide and its dispatch ID as the authoritative receipt source; reject a missing, invented or other-dispatch guide.

executionOrder.title: Close conforming receipt and dispatch atomically
executionOrder.action: Coordinate conforming receipt, dispatch COMPLETED and active-trip reservation closure in one transaction, with safe retries. Preserve histories and leave discrepancy handling explicit.
acceptance: A conforming closure commits reception and dispatch states together
A forced failure rolls back all state changes
An exact retry does not create another reception/case or repeat the closure
A completed dispatch no longer reserves its vehicle; late telemetry does not append to a closed trip
executionOrder.integrationDependency: Andre implementation required; Fabian verifies transit reservation and Leonardo verifies dispatch state.

executionOrder.action: Keep the agreed simple backend storage approach; verify actual upload bytes, persisted metadata, authenticated retrieval and ownership. An external URL or checklist is insufficient.
acceptance: Uploaded file survives service restart and can be retrieved by an authorized user
An upload error does not report a saved photograph or leave an orphan reference
